caption:
Jumbo — Jumbo Interactive's house band — play The Darkness' "I Believe in a Thing Called Love" at Battle of the Tech Bands Melbourne 2026, The Howler.

A flashback to June, when we took Battle of the Tech Bands to Melbourne for the first time. Four Melbourne bands competed and Jumbo came down as special guests.

Sydney is next, and it is close. Thursday 8 October at Manning Bar, with bands from Atlassian, Canva, Amazon and V2 AI, and Brisbane champions ShipReX joining as special guests. Tickets at battleofthetechbands.com

Watch it on YouTube: youtu.be/BOWhYAt2MlA
Full Melbourne set: youtu.be/2t0zoh-ZJO4
